title: Sony Japan temporarily suspends fulfillment of orders for nearly all of its CFexpress and SD memory card product lines due to solid state memory shortages (Jaron Schneider/PetaPixel)
summary: Jaron Schneider / PetaPixel: Sony Japan temporarily suspends fulfillment of orders for nearly all of its CFexpress and SD memory card product lines due to solid state memory shortages — The global shortage of solid state memory has claimed its first photographic victim, as Sony has announced that it is suspending fulfillment …
